topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series and outlines the key concepts and learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution, stem cells, and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic driver mutations and epigenetic chromatin alterations confer selective growth advantages that fuel clonal expansion and malignant transformation.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchies and cellular origin dictate malignant potential, presenting experimental evidence for stem cell-driven tumorigenesis in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences, Spatial Profiling, and Cancer Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote tumor initiation and sustain established growths, alongside the technologies used to study and synthesize tumor-microenvironment coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
